name: last30days-skill
summary: Multi-source research aggregator - Reddit, X, HN, Polymarket, YouTube, Bluesky, TikTok, Instagram. Scores, dedupes, synthesizes with citations. Watchlist mode for scheduled monitoring.

name: superpowers
summary: Agentic dev workflow framework - brainstorming, planning (2-5 min tasks), subagent-driven TDD, code review gates, git worktrees. Very opinionated. By Jesse Vincent.

name: goose
summary: Open-source, extensible AI agent from Block that can install, execute, edit, and test with multiple LLMs. Strong fit for agent workflow benchmarking.

name: caveman
summary: Token compression tool pitched as reducing prompt footprint while preserving utility. Could lower agent context cost and improve throughput on long workflows.

name: LiteRT-LM
summary: Google AI Edge runtime for local/on-device LLM inference. Relevant for lightweight mobile and edge-side agent experiments.
